acknowledge.text: Okay. A steady, ordinary place to be.

options.title: Which kind of okay?
options.why: A closer look can tell you whether today needs anything.
options.prompt: What kind of okay is today?

options.title: Add one good thing
options.text: Plan one small thing you would enjoy later today.
options.why: Something to look forward to can lift an ordinary day.

acknowledge.text: Sleepy. Your body might be asking for rest.

options.title: Rest if you can
options.text: If now is a good time, let yourself rest a little.
options.why: Listening to sleepiness can help you feel better later.

options.title: Wind down
options.text: If it is evening, dim the lights and put the phone down.
options.why: A gentle wind-down can make sleep come more easily.

acknowledge.text: Your attention is all over the place.

options.title: Come back to now
options.text: Notice five things you can see, then pick one task.
options.why: A moment of grounding can help gather scattered attention.

options.title: One thing at a time
options.text: Close what you do not need and give one thing a few minutes.
options.why: Fewer things in view can make focus easier.

acknowledge.text: You're not sure. That's a fine place to be for a while.

options.title: Write the options
options.text: What are the choices, and what does each one feel like?
options.why: Seeing options side by side can make a choice clearer.
options.prompt: My options, and how each feels:

options.title: What would help you decide?
options.text: What would help you feel sure?
options.why: Knowing what is missing can turn uncertainty into a next step.

acknowledge.text: A bit flat today. No highs, no lows.

options.title: A little movement
options.text: Stretch, step outside, or walk around for a few moments.
options.why: A little movement often lifts a flat feeling.

options.title: A small hello
options.text: Say hi to someone, even briefly.
options.why: A small interaction can add a bit of colour to a flat day.
